entities.summary: David Alejandro Cubillán León is a Venezuelan professional basketball player for the Trotamundos de Carabobo of the Superliga Profesional de Baloncesto (SPB). He played college basketball with the Marquette Golden Eagles, where he was a key part of Marquette's bench play.
